obc-platform.title: OBC – Basketball Center Management Platform
obc-platform.descriptionLong: All-in-one platform for managing registrations, documents, payments, and player tracking for the OBC basketball center (Ivory Coast). The platform centralizes operations and improves the daily efficiency of administrators, coaches, and super admins. Designed to manage over 200 players with real-time tracking.

objectives: Centralize all player and member data
Automate the registration process (pre-registration → validation → payment)
Provide real-time visibility to administrators
Enable differentiated role management (Super Admin, Admin, Supervisor, Coach)
Improve the experience for parents and players
features: Payment management (tracking, history, late payment alerts)
Alert system (pending registrations >48h, documents >7d, overdue payments)

feedback-ia-amiad.title: AI Predictions Feedback Platform
feedback-ia-amiad.descriptionLong: Complete platform for displaying AI predictions (provided by the AI team) and collecting user feedback. Designed for a partner organization (AMIAD), it centralizes model evaluation and continuously improves performance.

objectives: Create an ergonomic platform to display AI predictions
Collect and store user feedback in a structured way
Ensure traceability of evaluations for the AI team
features: Complete pipeline: retrieval → display → feedback → storage
metrics: Data standards defined with the AI team

ai-assistant-saas.title: AI Assistant for SaaS Platform
ai-assistant-saas.descriptionLong: AI assistant integrated directly into a web and mobile product. Designed to improve user experience, it offers classification, reformulation, and summarization features in real-time via WebSockets.

objectives: Create an AI assistant capable of helping users in real-time
Integrate OpenAI models adapted to needs (classification, reformulation, summarization)
Provide a smooth experience on web and mobile
features: Full pipeline: request → OpenAI API → transformation → display
Error handling, timeouts, and partial streaming

association-manager.title: Association Management Web App
association-manager.descriptionLong: Complete web application for association management: users, projects, teams, and documents. Microservices architecture with CI/CD, monitoring, and code quality analysis.

objectives: Digitize the internal management of an association
Build a robust platform with complete user and project management
Implement a scalable microservices architecture
features: Automated code quality analysis with SonarQube

ecg-arrhythmia-classification.title: Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification (ECG)
ecg-arrhythmia-classification.descriptionLong: Complete ECG signal preprocessing pipeline and classification using Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) to detect different types of arrhythmias.

objectives: Classify multiple types of arrhythmias from noisy ECG signals
Build a complete ML pipeline with preprocessing and RNN
Handle strong signal variability and imbalanced datasets

music-streaming-app.title: Music Streaming Application
music-streaming-app.descriptionLong: Music streaming application allowing audio track synchronization across multiple devices. Full-stack platform with upload, playlist, and user management.

objectives: Create a simple synchronized streaming application
Manage tracks, playlists, and users
Enable multi-device synchronization

multiplayer-game.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Game
multiplayer-game.descriptionLong: Complete client/server system allowing multiple players to participate in a real-time multiplayer game with synchronization and network optimization.

objectives: Create a multiplayer game with reliable real-time synchronization
Architect a client/server system
Optimize latency and movement security

ios-payment-system.title: iOS Payment System (Stripe + RevenueCat)
ios-payment-system.descriptionLong: Complete iOS subscription management solution with real-time synchronization via Stripe and RevenueCat. Tangible impact: over 100 new customers after deployment.

objectives: Automatically synchronize iOS subscriptions
Create a stable, scalable, and consistent solution
Ensure real-time reliability
metrics: Perfect synchronization between iOS, Stripe, and database
